The Challenge

Zero Brand Awareness — A Brand New Launch

Saffron City was a completely new project when Digital Amnik took over its marketing. There was no existing brand recall, no audience base, and no digital presence to build on. The biggest challenge was not just lead generation — it was first making the market aware that this project even existed, and then building enough trust for buyers to consider investing in it.

No Defined Meta Audience for Mid-Range Plot Buyers

Unlike ultra-luxury projects where HNI audiences are relatively well-defined on Meta, mid-range residential plot buyers don't have a clear, pre-built audience segment. The interest layers, income signals, and behavioural patterns for this buyer profile are scattered and overlapping — making standard targeting approaches ineffective and wasteful. This demanded a completely different strategy to identify and reach the right buyers at the right cost.

Strategy by Digital Amnik
1

Audience Fusion — Our Core Innovation

Since mid-range plot buyers have no pre-defined Meta audience, we developed an "Audience Fusion" approach — blending multiple interest clusters, behavioural signals, and income proxies to construct a custom composite audience. This allowed us to reach the right buyer profile at scale while continuously refining based on engagement and lead quality data, achieving a strong 6:4 good-to-bad lead ratio.

2

Awareness-First Meta Campaign

Before pushing for leads, we ran a targeted awareness phase on Facebook & Instagram to establish Saffron City's presence in the market. This brand-building foundation ensured that when lead generation ads launched, the audience already had familiarity and trust with the project — dramatically improving conversion rates.

3

Influencer Marketing for Local Credibility

We partnered with relevant local and regional influencers to build organic buzz and social proof around Saffron City. Authentic influencer content showcasing the township's location, layout, and investment potential created trust among fence-sitters and drove a significant volume of high-intent inquiries.

4

Lead Quality Optimisation

Rather than chasing volume alone, every campaign iteration was optimised for lead quality. Achieved an exceptional average CPL of just ₹50, with continuous A/B testing of creatives, landing pages, and audience segments — ensuring the sales team worked only the most promising 780 qualified leads from the 1200+ total pipeline.

5

Sales Funnel Acceleration

A structured follow-up system was deployed to nurture all 1200+ leads — segmenting them by intent and moving qualified prospects from inquiry to site visit to booking. WhatsApp sequences, personalised communication, and regular sales pipeline reviews kept conversion velocity high across the 6-month campaign window.

Impact for the Developer

Brand built from zero — Digital Amnik took Saffron City from a completely unknown launch to a recognised township brand in Kota within 6 months, establishing strong market presence and buyer trust.

18 plots sold at an exceptional CPL of ₹50 — for a mid-range project with no pre-existing audience definition on Meta, achieving ₹5.5 Crore in sales at this cost efficiency is a benchmark result.

Audience Fusion proved as a replicable model — the custom audience-building methodology developed for Saffron City solved a core problem for mid-range real estate marketing on Meta, and has since become a standard part of Digital Amnik's playbook.

120+ genuine site visits generated — every visit was a high-intent buyer, directly contributing to the 18 confirmed closings.

Starting from zero brand awareness and with no pre-defined Meta audience for mid-range plot buyers, Digital Amnik's Audience Fusion strategy, Meta Ads, and Influencer Marketing built Saffron City Gated Township into a recognised project — generating 1200+ leads, 780 qualified prospects, 120+ site visits, and closing 18 plots worth ₹5.5 Crore in just 6 months. This case study proves that even a fresh launch in a crowded mid-range market can achieve extraordinary results with the right digital architecture.
